title: Theatre performance platform classification and fire protection (Council Order 0015421)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The decision addresses whether a raised platform in a theatre was a “stage for theatrical performances” and whether Article 3.3.2.13 requirements for sprinklers, separation, deluge protection and venting applied.
The appeal record included a Building Code Equivalency Report prepared by an engineering company.

The order describes Building A as 715 m², one-storey, sprinklered, Group A Division 1, with an auditorium for up to 300; it also describes adjacent Building B as 446 m², Group A Division 2, not sprinklered.
